name: Goa
tagline: Beach Paradise Living on a Fraction of Western Costs
description: Goa is India's premier coastal retreat, blending Portuguese colonial charm with tropical beaches and an incredibly low cost of living. A thriving expat community, world-class seafood, and a laid-back vibe make it one of the most attractive FIRE destinations in Asia. From the lively beach shacks of North Goa to the quieter coves of the South, retirees can stretch their portfolios further here than almost anywhere else on Earth.

quickFacts.visa: India has no retirement, pension, or passive-income visa. US citizens use the e-Tourist visa — 30-day (multiple-entry) or 1-year/5-year (multiple-entry; the 5-year fee rose from $80 to $200 in 2026) — and may stay up to 180 days per visit, with total time capped at 180 days per calendar year; long-term residents get by cycling visas in and out. The only path to living in India indefinitely is the OCI card, open to people of Indian origin or those married 2+ years to an Indian citizen or OCI holder.
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – generally safe for tourists and expats
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Manohar International Airport (GOX, Mopa) – primary hub; Dabolim (GOI) secondary

housing.description: Modest 1BHK on the North-Goa fringe / Mapusa (inland of the beach-premium belt)

dining.description: Beach-shack meals + Goan thalis several times a week; cooks at home otherwise

healthcare.description: Individual private cover with Manipal Hospital Goa access — assumes an early retiree (45–55); older retirees should budget more

transportation.description: Owned scooter (fuel + maintenance), the standard Goa transport

entertainment.description: Beach life, yoga, night markets, occasional live music

1M.lifestyle: A frugal beach life — a modest 1BHK inland of the North-Goa premium belt, a scooter, home cooking supplemented by cheap shack thalis, and basic private cover. Comfortable and easy, though upscale beach-club dining and Western imports stay outside this budget.

housing.description: Beautiful 3BR villa with pool in Assagao or Vagator

dining.description: Mix of upscale beach restaurants, boutique cafes, and fine dining in Panjim

healthcare.description: Premium private insurance covering top hospitals in Goa and Mumbai

transportation.description: Own scooter plus occasional taxi and ride-hailing for longer trips

entertainment.description: Surfing lessons, premium yoga retreats, weekend trips to spice plantations and waterfalls

2M.lifestyle: A villa with a pool in Assagao or Vagator, dining out at good restaurants in Panjim and the beach clubs several times a week, and your own scooter plus taxis for longer trips. Good private health insurance covering Goa and Mumbai hospitals. Weekend trips to other parts of India are easily affordable. Day-to-day life is very comfortable and you rarely think about costs.

housing.description: Nice 1BHK or small villa in Assagao/Siolim/Candolim (tourist premium)

dining.description: Regular dining at good beach restaurants and Panjim cafés

healthcare.description: Solid individual cover; Goa + Mumbai hospital access

transportation.description: Scooter + occasional taxi/car rental for longer trips

entertainment.description: Yoga retreats, live music, boat trips, weekend getaways

3M.lifestyle: Comfortable beach living with margin — a small villa or good flat in the North-Goa lifestyle belt, dining out regularly, a scooter plus taxis, and easy weekend trips. Housing is the standout cost: the tourist market keeps prime-belt rents near metro levels.

housing.description: Oceanfront estate or heritage Portuguese villa with full amenities in prime North Goa

dining.description: Personal chef for daily meals plus fine dining experiences across Goa

healthcare.description: VIP concierge medical service, international coverage including Singapore and Bangkok hospitals

transportation.description: Luxury SUV with full-time driver, plus own scooter for leisure rides

entertainment.description: Private beach parties, art collecting, premium wellness programs, domestic and international travel

domesticHelp.description: Full-time cook, housekeeper, gardener, and part-time driver

luxuryExtras.description: Regular international travel, yacht charters, bespoke experiences, philanthropy in local communities

5M.lifestyle: A large oceanfront villa or heritage Portuguese property in prime North Goa. A housekeeper, cook, and gardener several times a week. A nice SUV with a driver, regular dining at Goa's best restaurants, and business class flights for longer trips. Premium healthcare with international coverage. The budget far exceeds what Goa's cost of living can absorb, so expect a large monthly margin.

housing.description: Beachfront or heritage Portuguese villa in prime North Goa

dining.description: Frequent fine dining across Goa’s strong restaurant scene

healthcare.description: International cover incl. Singapore/Bangkok hospital access

transportation.description: Car with full-time driver + scooter for leisure

domesticHelp.description: Cook + housekeeper scaled to one villa

10M.lifestyle: Luxury with Goa as the home-base — a beachfront villa, a driver, a cook and housekeeper, and a strong travel budget. Prime North-Goa villa rents are genuinely high (tourist/luxury market), so housing carries this tier; most at this level use Goa as a base and travel extensively.
